title: How to Set Up Locations in Business Central (2025)

chapters.title: Purchasing and Selling from Specific Locations
Using Transfer Orders to Move Items Between Locations
Checking Availability and Transfer Route Configuration

features.name: Multiple Locations Setup
features.description: Users can set up as many locations as needed and enter information about them on the location card within the warehouse manager role.

features.name: Intransit Locations
features.description: Users can specify intransit locations on the location card to track items during transfers between locations.

features.name: Inventory Posting Group per Location
features.description: Each location requires an inventory posting group to be set up to handle posting of inventory transactions.

features.name: Location Codes in Purchase Documents
features.description: Users can specify location codes when entering purchase documents to purchase items for specific locations.

features.name: Item Availability per Location
features.description: The item card displays availability of items at each location, allowing users to see where items are in stock.

features.name: Location Specification in Sales Documents
features.description: When selling items, users can choose the location from which to ship items by specifying the location code in the sales document.

features.name: Default Location on Customer Card
features.description: Users can specify a default location on the customer card to automatically ship items from that location for each customer.

features.name: Transfer Orders
features.description: Transfer orders document the movement of items from one location to another and allow flexible shipping and receiving in full, line by line, or partial quantities.

features.name: Direct Transfer
features.description: Transfer orders can use a direct transfer checkbox to move items between locations all at once without using an intransit location.

features.name: Transfer Routes
features.description: Transfer routes can be set up to pre-specify intransit locations for transfers, avoiding the need to select them each time. Specific shipping agents can also be specified for transfer routes.

features.name: Out of Stock Notification
features.description: Business Central can notify users when selling an item that is out of stock at a specific location.

features.name: Cross-Location Availability Check
features.description: Users can check availability of out-of-stock items in other locations and use various reports to check item availability at specific locations.

quotes.text: This video shows how to set up multiple locations for inventory and how to use transfer orders to move items between the locations.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core topics of the video - multiple locations setup and transfer orders for inter-location inventory movement.

quotes.text: We can set up as many locations as we need and enter information about them on the location card.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates that the system supports unlimited location configuration with flexible setup capabilities.

quotes.text: We'll need to set up an inventory posting group for each location.
quotes.why_it_matters: Specifies a key configuration requirement - each location requires a dedicated inventory posting group for proper financial posting.

quotes.text: When we need to move items from one location to another, we use transfer orders to document where the items went.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the primary mechanism for moving inventory between locations and maintaining audit trail.

quotes.text: If we move the items all at once, we can just choose the direct transfer check box on the transfer order.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes a transfer method option that simplifies transfers without requiring intransit locations.

quotes.text: To avoid selecting the intransit code every time, we can set up transfer routes where the location is already chosen.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights a setup optimization feature that reduces repetitive manual entry in transfer processes.

quotes.text: Business Central can let us know when we're selling an item that is out of stock at a specific location.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the only statement of the out-of-stock notification behavior.
